A few tips for a better route

Use one stop per line. For another city, use “Tait Avenue, Los Gatos”. Add an intersection or house number to narrow a street. Split “A and B” into separate lines if you want both.

Street and neighborhood markers represent an area, not a verified entrance. Check access and parking before driving.
